user.title: Choose a desk
user.description: Desks show up as `stand UP-` followed by four digits. Only desks whose TWD1 module speaks the original "protocol 1" are supported. Close the Stand Up Pls phone app first: the desk accepts only one Bluetooth connection.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No new desks found. Make sure the desk is powered, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and not connected to the phone app. Only TiMotion TWD1 desks ("stand UP-") using protocol 1 are supported.
abort.already_configured: This desk is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this desk is already in progress.

add_preset.title: Add a preset
add_preset.description: A preset is a named height. It appears in the Preset dropdown and moves the desk there when picked.

settings.title: Connection
settings.description: The desk accepts a single Bluetooth connection. Keeping it open gives live height, including moves made with the handset, but locks the phone app out. When off, Home Assistant connects only to send a command and lets go after 30 seconds.

error.name_exists: A preset with this name already exists.
